_note: S12 — starting loadouts. Ruled 2026-08-25: KITS ARE PER-HERO, WITH A CLASS BACKUP. The class kit is the default every hero of that class starts with; a hero override replaces it entirely. Random picks are stored as SPECS, never rolled here — content is deterministic and the roll belongs to the draft (named stream, keyed by what the roll is). Every explicit id must exist and every random pool must be non-empty: audit R35.

class.warrior.why: Ruled 2026-08-25: each warrior gets a random two-handed tier-1 weapon. Pool is 17 strong.

class.mage.why: Ruled 2026-08-25: a random tier-1 staff — fire, frost, earth, lightning or force.

class.priest.why: Ruled 2026-08-25: one of the two holy symbols dictated in the past — 2-ACTIONS-NOTES already ruled 'Holy Symbol and Priest Chain → Priest', and both exist at tier 1.

class.rogue.why: Ruled 2026-08-21 (S12 pre-ruling): the Rogue starts with daggers; the missing tier-1 / throwing dagger is deferred, and this kit is flagged provisional rather than blocking on it.

class.ranger.why: BACKUP ONLY — all four Eve rangers carry hero overrides (their bows were dictated). A generic ranger with no override gets a shortbow until ruled otherwise; flagged provisional because it was never dictated.

class.paladin.why: BACKUP ONLY — the four Eve paladins carry hero overrides. Sword and board as the class default mirrors three of the four dictations; flagged provisional because the class-level default itself was never dictated.

class.civilian.why: Civilians have no class default — every fielded civilian carries a dictated per-hero kit via gen/civilian-rulings.json statBlocks (Pile of Rocks, Lumberjack's Axe, Pitchfork, or nothing).

class.beast.why: Beasts fight with what they are. Natural attacks, no items.

heroKits._note: Per-hero overrides — dictated during the Eve differentiation pass, recorded in gen/eve-differentiation.json startingItems and mirrored here as the S12 registry. A hero listed here ignores its class kit.

civilianKitsLiveIn: gen/civilian-rulings.json statBlocks — same per-hero principle, dictated with their stat blocks.
